name: huggingface/atif-scan
title: safeagents checks tool calls before they run
summary: safeagents is a Python proxy that scans each tool call before execution using about 110 deterministic detectors from atif-scan. It can block sandbox side channels, network-isolation bypasses, and reward-hacking edits, or log them in a no-block mode, and it can ask a small decision model about calls the rules already flag.

appearances.title: safeagents proxy checks tool calls before they run
appearances.summary: safeagents is a new Python proxy that inspects an LLM's tool calls before execution and can sit in front of a coding harness. Built on atif-scan, it blocks sandbox escapes, proxy bypasses, and reward-hacking moves such as editing tests or writing reward.txt, with a log-only mode and an optional decision-model verdict.
